cases.prompt: Choose between an existing CLI, direct MCP tools, constrained code execution, and code-over-MCP for this agent integration, then define how to benchmark the candidates.
Review this existing MCP implementation for OAuth confused-deputy attacks, SSRF, token passthrough, and secret exposure.
Review this pull request diff for correctness bugs, edge cases, and missing tests.
Audit this authentication endpoint for authorization bypasses, injection, and leaked secrets.
Turn this vague product request into an agreed specification with requirements and non-goals.
Break this approved specification into ordered implementation tasks with acceptance checks.
Examine the staged patch for behavioral regressions and decide whether it is safe to merge.
Threat model the new webhook integration, including SSRF, ownership, and untrusted payload risks.
Define the requirements, API data contract, error cases, privacy constraints, and rollout criteria.
Sequence the accepted design into dependency-aware delivery tasks and identify parallel work.
Coordinate four agents in separate git worktrees with exclusive file ownership, dependency waves, and one-branch-at-a-time integration.
Launch a GitHub-hosted Copilot cloud-agent task with GPT-5.6 Sol, create a pull request, and report the observed session model and task URL.
Audit this suspiciously green invariant test, prove it fails under a production mutation, and check that the build leaves tracked output clean.
Break the approved migration into independent tasks and identify which tasks can be assigned in parallel.
Implement this feature test-first by writing a failing behavior test, making it pass, and then refactoring.
Map this unfamiliar repository's entry points, architecture boundaries, build commands, tests, and safest change site without editing files.
Update the README, command reference, and changelog so they remain accurate after this user-visible CLI change.
Assess this third-party Agent Skill before adoption for provenance, licensing, instruction safety, overlap, and maintenance risk.
Rebase this completed feature branch, create an atomic commit, prepare the pull request, and clean up safely after merge.
Restructure this module and remove proven dead code without changing observable behavior, checking the baseline between mechanical steps.
Inspect this repository and create repository-specific agent instructions that capture its commands, conventions, and safety boundaries.
Build and update the repository's evidence-linked decision graph so architecture claims remain anchored to code, tests, and commits.
Create a new Agent Skill with valid frontmatter, routing triggers, progressive disclosure, and positive and negative activation prompts.
Reproduce this failing test, isolate the root cause from the exact error output, and fix the defect rather than its symptom.
Before reporting this implementation complete, run fresh targeted validation, inspect the diff, and confirm the original symptom is gone.
Research the current version of this external API using primary documentation, corroborate the claim, and cite authoritative URLs.
Run a bounded read-only Shadow scan of the payments boundary and return evidence-linked candidate observations without creating decisions.
Use these accepted constraints and candidate observations to compare future-state architectures, migration stages, rollback, and risks without approving one.
The proposal has explicit human approval. Record it in the .shadow graph, preserve accepted history, and update the authoritative index.
Read-only validate the .shadow graph against current implementation and report aligned, drifted, stale, and unknown decisions without repairs.
I only need to record this already reviewed current-state architecture decision; do not run the full observation or future-state lifecycle.
The future-state Shadow proposal is complete but no human approval artifact exists yet; keep it proposed and do not record an accepted decision.
Use Wayfinder to chart this long-running ambiguous initiative as one decision map. Keep dependent uncertainty in fog of war and create only the currently sharp frontier tickets.
Resume this Wayfinder decision map across sessions: claim one open, unblocked, unclaimed frontier ticket, resolve that decision, synchronize the map and fog, then stop.

Decision discovery is complete and the Wayfinder fog is empty. Turn the cleared map and linked decisions into an agreed requirements specification with interfaces, non-goals, risks, and acceptance criteria.
The Wayfinder handoff is complete and this specification is approved. Decompose it into ordered implementation tasks with dependencies, ownership, acceptance criteria, and verification commands.
Decision discovery and task planning are finished. Execute the approved tasks with agents in separate git worktrees, enforce non-overlapping ownership, integrate the branches, and verify the result.
The Wayfinder decisions are settled and implementation is complete. Create the feature branch and atomic commit, rebase onto main, push, and open the pull request.
